# KaTeX runtime assets

Version: 0.18.4

Source: the published `katex@0.18.4` npm package.

Included unchanged:

- `dist/katex.min.js`
- `dist/katex.min.css`
- `dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js`
- `dist/fonts/*.woff2`
- upstream `LICENSE`

Only local file URLs load these assets. The preview template has no network dependency and never sends draft content to KaTeX or another service.
